summary: Monroe Capital Income Plus Corp filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered sale of 1,174,995 common shares at $9.77/share for $11.5M under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S, and a $0.071/share dividend with record/pay dates May 21/27, 2026. Net asset value per share was $9.77 as of April 30, 2026. These are routine capital-raising and dividend actions, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or termination elements. The filing is a standard current report for a BDC's periodic equity issuance and distribution declaration.
